question_text: Was the Samsung Securities data breach a hack?
answer_text: By the company's account, yes: an outside party got into its customer-feedback system and took files from 8,241 clients. That rests on its own statement. Method and attacker are not established.
label: Reported

question_text: How many Samsung Securities clients were affected?
answer_text: The company says 8,241 clients, all of whom had filed a VOC submission. No outside check yet.
label: Reported

question_text: Who was behind the Samsung Securities breach?
label: Not established

label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A company or regulator report on the cause.

label: Not established
